title: exec-TV coverage seam: the forge-level ExecVerdict::Divergent mapping is not directly asserted by a test (discharge is private + the faithful lowerer never triggers it; teeth bite at the obligation layer E1-E4). Add a forge-level end-to-end teeth (test-only fault-inject a wrong production -> assert Divergent)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Forge-level Divergent teeth landed (test-only). Added `#[cfg(test)] mod divergent_teeth` in forge/src/exec_tv.rs (+193 LOC, no production-logic change; `discharge` reached via `super::` — no visibility tweak needed since a child mod sees parent-private items).

Pins the forge classification mapping the obligation-layer E1-E4 teeth do not reach:
- faithful_production_classifies_faithful: P=`a + b` (faithful) -> ExecVerdict::Faithful (positive control).
- wrong_value_production_classifies_divergent: P=`a.wrapping_sub(b)` for `a + b` -> verus postcondition counterexample (errors>=1 arm) -> Divergent.
- non_compiling_production_classifies_divergent: P=`n - 1 as u8` for `(n - 1) as u8` (#122 paren-drop, E0308) -> verus compile abort (!status.success no-results arm) -> Divergent.
- degenerate_no_obligation_classifies_unverifiable: zero-obligation program (0 verified, 0 errors, success) -> Unverifiable (pins the Divergent-vs-Unverifiable boundary, the masking-path concern).

Verified under real verus (all 4 ran, none hit the skip path). BOTH Divergent triggers covered (counterexample + non-compile).

Gauntlet: build OK; cargo test --workspace 756 passed, 0 failed; clippy -D warnings clean; fmt --check clean; cargo tree -p thermite-tv has no thermite-lower (N-version boundary intact).

contract_tv.rs has the analogous untested-Divergent seam (private `discharge` + `ClauseVerdict::Divergent`); deliberately NOT widened here (#157 is scoped to exec-tv) — left for its own blocker.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Add a test-only forge-level Divergent teeth in forge/src/exec_tv.rs: a #[cfg(test)] mod that builds real exec obligations with a deliberately-wrong P_production and discharges them through the actual private `discharge` fn (reached via super::, no visibility tweak), asserting Faithful (control), Divergent via postcondition counterexample, Divergent via non-compile (#122 paren-drop), and Unverifiable for a degenerate zero-obligation program. No production-logic change. Gauntlet: build + test --workspace + clippy -D warnings + fmt --check + cargo tree -p thermite-tv (no thermite-lower).
